title: Warm Crispy Japanese Eggs Tamagoyaki
description: A tangy and crispy Japanese dish featuring graham cracker crumbs and render fat, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this tamagoyaki recipe is onion and garlic free.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan to medium high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and salt until well combined.
Add the water to the bowl and whisk until smooth.
Sprinkle the graham cracker crumbs onto a plate or shallow dish.
Using a ladle, pour a small amount of the egg mixture onto the teppan and tilt to evenly coat the bottom.
Sprinkle a few grams of the graham cracker crumbs onto the egg mixture.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the egg towards the center, allowing the uncooked egg to flow to the edges.
Once the egg is almost set, use the spatula to shape into a rectangular tamagoyaki shape.
Brush the render fat onto the teppan and cook the tamagoyaki for an additional 30 seconds to crisp the bottom.
Remove the tamagoyaki from the teppan and serve warm.
